signIn.title: Sign in to submit a version.
signIn.body: A version belongs to an account, and GitHub is how the platform knows which one. Signing in is the whole account — there is nothing else to fill in.

seasonNotOpen.title: {season} is not taking submissions.
seasonNotOpen.bodyNone: This game has no open season. A season is scheduled by an administrator, and submitting starts working on its opening date with no action from you. Your models are still on [their ladders]({ladders}).
seasonNotOpen.bodyScheduled: It opens on {date}. Until then there is nothing to enter — the form below is what you will use when it does. Your models are still on [their ladders]({ladders}).
seasonNotOpen.bodySettling: Submissions closed on {date} and the season is settling: the matches already queued are being played out and the ratings are being counted. The next season opens when an administrator schedules it. Your models are still on [their ladders]({ladders}).

notAParticipant.title: Your account is not a participant in this season yet.
notAParticipant.body: Signing in worked — this season is only open to invited accounts while the platform is in its first run. Nothing is wrong with your model. When the season opens to everyone, this page starts working with no action from you.

versionInFlight.title: This model already has a version in flight.
versionInFlight.body: {model} v{version} is {phase}, and one version of a model goes through admission at a time. Wait for [it to finish]({path}) — if it is rejected you can submit again immediately. Your other models are unaffected.
versionInFlight.bodyUnknown: One version of a model goes through admission at a time.

weightsEntered.title: These weights are already entered in this season.
weightsEntered.body: A season may count one entry per set of weights, so re-submitting the same file cannot give you a second place on the ladder. Train a different model, or change the manifest and rebuild — either changes the hash.

noModel.title: You have no model in {game} yet.
noModel.body: A version belongs to a model, and a model is a name. [Make one on Your models](/me?new=1) — it is one field and enters nothing — then come back here to submit its first version.

form.modelPrompt: Which of your models is this a version of?
form.idle: Read and hashed here; the file itself is uploaded when you submit.
form.hint: Both files are hashed in your browser and uploaded straight to the object store — nothing is sent through the site, and the platform re-hashes what arrives. See [submitting a version](/docs/competing/submitting).
form.hintNext: Both files are hashed in your browser and uploaded straight to the object store — nothing is sent through the site, and the platform re-hashes what arrives. This would be v{next}. See [submitting a version](/docs/competing/submitting).

noHash.title: This browser cannot hash the files here.
noHash.body: `crypto.subtle` exists only over https or on localhost, and this page was served over neither. Submit through the API instead — [submitting a version](/docs/competing/submitting) has the two calls.

form.reassure: Submitting replaces nothing yet. Your active version keeps playing until the new one passes its trial.

pick.notJson: {name} is not JSON, so it is not a manifest. Pick manifest.json.

checks.title: What the platform checks
items: Both hashes match what arrived, byte for byte.
The manifest declares shapes the graph actually has, and its adapters run inside the operation budget.
Model and manifest together fit a weight class — that measurement decides which.
These weights have not been entered in this season before.

items.name: uploaded
items.said: This page hashes both files and PUTs them straight to the object store. Nothing goes through the site.

items.name: submitted
items.said: We re-hash what arrived and check the list above.

items.name: admitted
items.said: It is measured, given a class, and queued.

items.name: trial
items.said: One match against a baseline. It has to finish below the strike limit; it does not have to win.

items.name: active
items.said: It replaces this model’s previous version and starts earning a rating on Open and on its class. Your other models keep playing.

classes.title: The weight classes
classes.hint: You do not pick a class. The measured size picks it — the graph's bytes plus the manifest's — and an entry over the largest cap is refused.
classes.hintSeason: You do not pick a class. The measured size picks it — the graph's bytes plus the manifest's — and an entry over the largest cap is refused. These are {season}'s caps; a season can change them.

uploaded.title: {model} v{version} is in. Both files uploaded.
uploaded.body: Your browser hashed both files and PUT them straight to the object store — nothing went through the site. Admission re-hashes what arrived, measures it into a class and runs the probe; the version page carries the verdict, usually within minutes.

uploadFailed.title: {model} v{version} is recorded, but {which} did not upload.
uploadFailed.body: The version exists — {reason}. **Finish it with the commands below**: both URLs are one-shot, good for {expires}, and admission starts the moment the second file lands. That is the recovery, and it costs nothing.
uploadFailed.again: Submitting again works too while those URLs are good: it answers with fresh ones for the same version, expiring at the same time. After that admission gives up on it — `ARTIFACT_MISSING` or `MANIFEST_MISSING` — and the next submission is a new version with a new number.
uploadFailed.finishEnd: from the directory holding the two files
uploadFailed.comment: # the same PUTs the page was making, from a shell
uploadFailed.put: A `PUT` with the file as the whole body; no headers and no account needed. Anything whose SHA-256 is not what you declared is refused at admission with the hash it measured.

refusals.season_not_open: The season stopped taking submissions between loading this page and pressing the button. Nothing was recorded.
refusals.not_a_participant: This season is only open to invited accounts at the moment. Nothing is wrong with your model.
refusals.version_in_flight: This model already has a version in admission{inFlight}. One version of a model goes through at a time; your other models are unaffected.
refusals.weights_already_entered: Those weights are already entered in this season. A season counts one entry per set of weights.
refusals.unknown_model: That is not a model of yours. Make one on Your models first — an unknown entry is never adopted silently, or a typo would quietly start a second lineage with its own version numbers.
refusals.model_retired: That model is retired and takes no new versions. Revive it on Your models, or submit to another one.
refusals.too_many_in_flight: You are at this season’s limit for how many of your versions may be in admission at once. Wait for one to reach a verdict.
refusals.too_many_versions: You have entered as many versions as this season allows. That limit is per season, so the next one starts you fresh.
refusals.cooling_down: This model submitted very recently. This season asks for a gap between versions; try again shortly.
refusals.hashes_required: Both hashes are required, each as sha256: followed by 64 hexadecimal characters. Run `shasum -a 256 model.onnx manifest.json` (`sha256sum` on Linux) on the two files you are about to upload.
